title: Existing orphan library entries are preserved, still editable and linkable
custom_preconds:
1. You are on the Parts -> Part Library page on the build under test, with "Part Library & Inventory - Create & Edit".
  2. A library entry that has no inventory part behind it already exists.
custom_steps:
1. Confirm existing entries (including ones nothing references) stay in the list and are not deleted or hidden.
  2. Open such an orphan entry's detail page and edit it.
  3. Create a new inventory part with that entry's number and confirm it links to the existing entry; confirm the public API create endpoint is unchanged.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Library entries that already exist stay in the list, including ones nothing references (this spec does not delete or hide them); an orphan entry is still editable from its detail page and is still the entry a later part with that number links to.
  • The public API create endpoint is a separate integration surface and is not changed by the removal of the standalone create.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; "Parts Lifecycle Update" PRD (Confluence 829227015, IN REVIEW 2026-09-09), Story 11 (Part Library browse & edit only); design canvas Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026 against an IN-REVIEW spec; not yet build-verified.
